trialDays: First {days} days free. Any sign-up fee is due today; the membership price starts after the trial.
dueTodayTrial: Any sign-up fee and its taxes are due today. Save a card for the first membership payment at the end of your trial.
dueTodayFree: There is no recurring membership charge. Any sign-up fee and its taxes are due today.
cardBody: Your details and signed waivers are saved. Save a card for future membership payments. No payment is due today; your membership starts once card setup is confirmed.
confirmingCardBody: We are confirming your saved card, which usually takes a few seconds. If this page does not change, select Check again.
confirmingCardProgress: Waiting for card setup to be confirmed…
cancelledCardBody: Your membership has not started. Return to card setup to save a card for future payments, or start again.
manualBody: Your registration is saved. This invoice cannot be paid by card. Contact the gym to arrange a manual payment; your membership will activate after payment is recorded.
title: Join
plansHelp: Choose a membership to join online. Sign the waivers, then pay any amount due today or save a card for future payments.
noPlans: Online joining is not available right now. Please contact the gym to become a member.
formHelp: Enter the contact details for whoever pays, then the details of each person joining. Each person needs every waiver signed; a parent or legal guardian signs for anyone under 18.
dueToday: Due today for each person: the first period plus any sign-up fee. Taxes, if any, are added at payment. Later payments are charged to the saved card on the same date each period.
guardian: I am the parent or legal guardian
signatureHelp: Draw your signature or select a PNG signature image below.
signatureFile: Choose a signature image (PNG, up to 256 KB)
consent: I have read and agree to this document.
failed: We could not save your details. Check them and try again, or contact the gym.
conflict: The waivers or membership have changed. Reload this page and review them again.
tooLarge: The signature images are too large to send together. Draw the signatures here, or choose smaller PNG files.
signatureRequired: Please draw or choose a signature image for each document.
unavailable: Online joining is not available right now. Please contact the gym to become a member.
retry: The server is busy. Your details have not been saved yet. Wait a moment, then try again.
limited: Too many attempts from this connection. Wait a few minutes, then try again, or contact the gym.
continueBody: Your details and signed waivers are saved. Pay securely to start your membership. Nothing is active until payment is confirmed.
confirmingBody: We are confirming your payment, which usually takes a few seconds. If this page does not change, select Check again.
confirmingProgress: Waiting for your payment to be confirmed…
confirmingStalled: This is taking longer than usual. Select Check again, or contact the gym if it does not move on.
welcomeEmail: Your membership is active. We sent a sign-in link to the email address you entered. Open it to set up your member portal login.
resent: If your membership email can receive a portal login, a new sign-in link is on its way. Use the newest email.
welcomePassword: Your membership is active. The gym confirms your member portal login: staff check your details, then give you a private link to set your password. If you already have a login with this email address, you will enter its current password instead.
cancelledBody: Nothing was charged and your membership has not started. You can return to payment while this page stays open, or start again.
closedTitle: This sign-up can't be paid online
closedBody: The gym has closed this payment, so nothing more can be done from this page. Please contact the gym to finish joining.
missingTitle: We can't find your sign-up here
missingBody: This browser no longer has your sign-up, so nothing more can be done from this page. If you completed payment, your membership starts once the payment is confirmed: look for a sign-in link in your email, or contact the gym to set up your portal login. Otherwise, start again.
